source.where: games.fun research/studio-v2/evals/cases/T3.json (frozen 2026-10-06; the creator dropped an ethnic framing that day, and this is the prompt as frozen after it)

prompt: token vs jeets, defend the token price

ledger.means: A token price is on screen as the thing everyone defends: it falls when attackers get through, and the round is lost if it crashes
Jeets come in waves trying to dump the price
Players have a direct way to stop jeets (hit, shoot, block) and can see it work
The token has a mascot or a face in the world

multiplayer.bar: Two players in one game, in sync: each screen shows the other player as a character where they really are, in the same round or run, and each sees their own score as their own.

policy: Jeets are paper-hand creatures with no nationality or ethnicity

control.text: The game includes a working chess board
